faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions

whatIsMorkBorg.a: MÖRK BORG is a doom metal album of a game. A rules-light, art-heavy tabletop RPG about lost souls seeking redemption in a bleak world. The game is published by Free League Publishing.

whatIsScvmGrinder.a: Scvm Grinder is a free character sheet and generator for MÖRK BORG. It helps you create characters, track stats, and manage equipment during your games.

isItFree.a: Yes! Scvm Grinder is completely free to use. You can create and save characters without paying anything.

guestVsAccount.a: No! You can use Scvm Grinder as a guest. Your character will be saved for 7 days. If you create an account, your characters are saved permanently and you can access them from any device.

howToSave.q: How do I save my character?
howToSave.a: Characters are saved automatically as you make changes. As a guest, your character is stored for 7 days. Sign up for a free account to keep your characters forever.

multipleCharacters.a: Yes! With an account, you can create and switch between multiple characters. Access your character list from the menu.

mobileSupport.a: Yes! Scvm Grinder is designed to work on phones, tablets, and desktops. Use it at the table or on the go.

offlineUse.a: Currently, Scvm Grinder requires an internet connection. Offline support may be added in the future.

bugReport.q: I found a bug! How do I report it?
bugReport.a: Please report bugs via GitHub issues or contact us directly. We appreciate your help making Scvm Grinder better!

faq.morkBorgCredit: MÖRK BORG is © Free League Publishing. This is an independent fan project.

privacy.subtitle: Data, Tracking, and Storage Notice

sections.storage: Browser storage is required for core operation. We store technical and gameplay data on your device, including language settings, session flags, active character references, and privacy preferences.
sections.backend: Character and gameplay content that you enter in this app is transmitted to and stored on our backend services, including guest sessions. This storage occurs even if you do not create an account.
sections.analytics: If analytics is enabled below, Google Analytics is used to process usage events and page activity. You can disable analytics at any time without losing core app functionality.
sections.sensitiveData: Do not enter sensitive personal data in character fields. By continuing to use this app, you acknowledge and accept this notice.

privacy.analyticsEnabledState: Analytics is currently enabled. You may disable it now or later in this panel.
privacy.analyticsDisabledState: Analytics is currently disabled. Core app features continue to work.
privacy.consentConfirmation: Selecting "{{action}}" confirms your agreement to this notice.
